  14. What are topics from this class you wanted to spend more time on?
  15. Facilities: What can I do to improve the classroom environment? I tried to have a quality headset for zoom meetings. I have been using the stock camera on my laptop, or the cameras I have for video. I felt like Discord also provided a way to communicate with the class and others outside the class. What can I do better to help make the environment better? I have heard that others are using overlays on top of Zoom. Is this something that would be beneficial? It has been requested that we add longer ethernet cords and power strips at some of the stations here on campus to allow people to bring their own computers and connect to class. Are there other things we can do to improve course delivery? One policy I am going to change for next year is that I am going to share multiple links in the syllabus for my dropbox folder. One will be for the curated class videos. A second will be for my storage drive where I keep my videos. And I will only use 1 link for all my classes and office hours and meetings. That way we don’t need to ever ask what the link is and you know where to go to find me if you need anything.
  16. Attendance: I want to know you are engaged with this class. In the past I could walk around and see what was up on your screens. Times have changed. What would you like to see for an attendance policy next semester? Here is the current idea. I will call roll every day we have class. This will be for your attendance grade.
